# `Q-24-4` — Warning From the Document Reader

> The converter reported a warning while reading the file. The import continued; the message is pandoc's own.

## What this means

pandoc's reader printed a `[WARNING]` while reading the file, for example about an element it could not represent. The import went ahead and the warning text is passed through.

## Why this happens

- The document uses a construct the reader only partly supports.

## How to fix

Check the imported document for the construct the warning names. The warning is informational; no action is required.
